items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: But Tony Mottola was the king to me. I just loved the way he played.

ctx.x: I really have to mention Tony Mottola, one of my favorites, besides Les Paul of course, who I work with. But Tony Mottola was the king to me. I just loved the way he played.
